sources.label: Open-source Material 3 Expressive UI, privacy routing & local APK security scann
sources.author: SadMod
patch_list: Replaces the ad-supported UI and packer runtime with a clean Material 3 Expressive client featuring Quad9 DoH, Tor/SOCKS5 proxy routing, a pre-install APK security scanner, and an on-device permission editor.
